notes.title: Snowdome English Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
Snowdome, a kinetic novel by Lunatic Works, now has an English version available.

Snowdome is a genre-shift kinetic novel built in Unity, with a high amount of special effects and full Mandarin voice acting. This 6-hour adventure will take you from plot twist to plot twist, set in a world where realism meets the realm of fantasy.

Snowdome is now 20% off for the Steam Winter Sale. After the discount period, we will raise the price for English language markets to US$6.99.
